info.title: piston
info.description: Continuous .NET test backend with stdio and HTTP MCP test tools and a web dashboard.

commands.name: coverage-export
commands.description: Export the running daemon's coverage report as LCOV or Cobertura XML.

options.name: --pipe-name
options.description: Override the named pipe name (default: auto-generated from solution path).

options.name: --format
options.description: Report format: lcov or cobertura. [default: lcov]

options.name: --output
options.description: File to write. Defaults to standard output.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Path to the .sln, .slnx, or .slnf file. Defaults to .piston.json's solution, then a unique solution in the current directory.

commands.name: daemon
commands.description: Start the Piston daemon in the foreground.

options.name: --debounce
options.description: File-change debounce interval in milliseconds. [default: 0]

options.name: --filter
options.description: Substring or regex to filter test names on startup.

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Enable code coverage collection (default: on), overriding .piston.json.

options.name: --no-coverage
options.description: Disable code coverage collection, overriding .piston.json.

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Maximum number of concurrent dotnet test processes. 0 = auto. [default: 0]

options.name: --stdio
options.description: Use stdin/stdout for Piston JSON-RPC transport (not MCP).

options.description: Use named-pipe transport, overriding the .piston.json stdio setting.

options.name: --pipe-name
options.description: Override the named pipe name (default: auto-generated from solution path).

options.name: --mcp-port
options.description: Port for the MCP server (default: 5200, or mcpPort in .piston.json).

options.name: --web-port
options.description: Port for the web UI and WebSocket server. [default: 5199]
